description: DB-migration style: write the three missing down migrations for existing up migrations (initial tables with a foreign key, an added column plus index, a table rename with a new column, an extra table and a view). A protected checks script runs up, down, up on an in-memory SQLite database with foreign keys on and compares schema snapshots (columns, foreign keys, indexes, object names) and row data after every step, so wrong drop order, a forgotten index or a drop-and-recreate that loses rows are all caught.
